transition: NZDT ends. At 2027-04-04T03:00 local the clocks go back to 02:00, so every local wall time from 02:00 to 02:59 happens twice.
why_it_is_here: Cinemas run marathons through 2am. Two genuinely distinct screenings sit at the same local_wall one hour apart, and a natural key that does not carry local_wall_offset collides them: the second overwrites the first, and a measurement series is quietly missing a screening that cannot be back-filled later.

sessions.label: the first 02:30, still on daylight time
the second 02:30, one hour later, on standard time
